title: 30A White Dunes Retreat
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “30A White Dunes Retreat” formerly Maison De la Mer, a luxury 7-bed, 9.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 30 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Carriage House, Rooftop Deck, Elevator, & Golf Cart. Boo
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Luxury beach compound - Private Resort-Style Pool and Spa (50ft by 29ft)(Pool can be heated for an additional $100 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Carriage House - Gulf Views from 4th floor deck - Short Walk to the Beach - Elevator - Perfect for weddings and events with a 3500 square feet pool deck - 6 Seater Golf Cart Included - 6 Adult Bicycles Include Experience unparalleled luxury and coastal elegance at this extraordinary beachside sanctuary. Nestled just moments away from the pristine shores of Blue Mountain Beach on 30A, this opulent retreat sets the standard for discerning travelers seeking the pinnacle of relaxation and refinement. Boasting striking architectural design and a commanding vertical presence, this home epitomizes sophistication. Ascend to new heights with a fourth-story lookout deck offering panoramic views of the azure coastline. Step inside to discover a haven of tranquility and sophistication, where every detail has been meticulously curated for your comfort and pleasure. A private elevator effortlessly connects all levels, ensuring seamless access throughout the property. Lounge by the resort-style pool and spa, set amidst a sprawling 3500-square-foot deck enveloped in secluded privacy. Indulge your culinary desires in the cabana's summer kitchen, where the tantalizing aroma of coastal cuisine mingles with the gentle sea breeze. Cozy up by the fireplace in the cabana, adding a touch of warmth to cooler evenings. With four levels of meticulously designed porch space, bask in the sun and savor the coastal ambiance. This expansive residence accommodates up to 30 guests across its lavishly appointed levels, making it an idyllic setting for memorable gatherings and special occasions. The ground floor invites you to unwind in style, featuring lofty 12-foot ceilings, a spacious living room with a fireplace, and an expansive dining area flooded with natural light. The chef's kitchen is a culinary masterpiece, boasting a vast quartz-topped island, custom vent hood, and premier Thermador appliances. Retreat to the main living area, where plush seating and modern fixtures create an atmosphere of unparalleled comfort. Upstairs, two elegant king suites await, each adorned with luxurious amenities and a private ensuite bathroom. The second floor also features a convenient laundry room and a living area with a wet bar for added convenience. Venture to the third level to discover one king bedroom and one bedroom with two queen beds each with ensuite bathrooms, along with a bunk room accommodating up to eight guests. An additional living room offers a serene retreat, with a spiral staircase leading to breathtaking gulf views from the fourth-floor tower. Outside, the sun-drenched pool beckons guests to unwind, while shaded lounge spaces and outdoor dining areas provide endless opportunities for relaxation and entertainment. For beach enthusiasts, two convenient access points are just a short stroll or bike ride away. Embark on coastal adventures with the included 6-seater Golf Cart and 6 Adult Bicycles, allowing you to explore the surrounding area with ease. The carriage house, connected to the main residence by an all-weather breezeway, offers additional accommodation with its vaulted ceilings, king bedroom, full kitchen, and laundry facilities. Experience the epitome of luxury living at this enchanting beachside retreat, where every moment is infused with unparalleled comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. Pool bath: There is a full pool bath adjacent to pool, so guests do not need to track to the house to use bath room. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor -King Bedroom - Private bathroom with Shower only Second Floor -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub -Sleeper Sofa in Common Area Third Floor -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only -Two Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Sleeper Sofa in Living Room - Shared Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub - Bunk Room - Two Queen over Queen Bunks and Sleeper Sofa- Private Bathroom with Shower Only Carriage House -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only -Sleeper sofa in Living Area Public Beach Access with parking and restrooms is less than 0.5 a mile away.
